# statuspage Provider

Terraform provider for managing Statuspage.io resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    statuspage = {
      source = "winebarrel/statuspage"
    }
  }
}

provider "statuspage" {
  api_key = "your-api-key"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The Statuspage.io API key. Can also be set via STATUSPAGE_API_KEY environment variable.
